### `class SeedSweepCommand` — `src/seedsweep/java/grounded_villages/harness/SeedSweepCommand.java`
GV-10's dev-only sweep command, and the seedSweep Gradle task's automated hook into it.
- `void register()` — Called reflectively; see the class doc.

### `class SeedSweepRunner` — `src/seedsweep/java/grounded_villages/harness/SeedSweepRunner.java`
GV-10's headless seed-sweep harness core: finds the first village near spawn on a live, already-booted ServerLevel (the runServer-per-seed fallback named in docs/spec/operations/testing.md "Verification for the first ticket" -- the datagen-shaped approach was spiked and rejected, see the ticket's own report for why), and measures it exactly as docs/spec/domains/site.md §3 defines "height spread" and "water fraction": sampled via ChunkGenerator#getBaseHeight/ChunkGenerator#getBaseColumn at OCEAN_FLOOR_WG/WORLD_SURFACE_WG -- the same pre-placement column queries JigsawPlacement itself uses -- not by reading blocks vanilla has already placed.
- `VillageSweepResult run(MinecraftServer server, long seed, Path outputFile)` — Finds the nearest village to server's overworld spawn, samples its footprint, and writes the result as JSON to outputFile.

### `class SeedSweepStats` — `src/seedsweep/java/grounded_villages/harness/SeedSweepStats.java`
Pure statistics used by the seed-sweep harness (GV-10): the 90th-minus-10th-percentile height spread and the water-fraction calculation defined in docs/spec/domains/site.md §3.
- `double percentile(List<Integer> values, double p)` — Linear-interpolation percentile (the same "nearest-rank with interpolation" method numpy's default percentile uses).
- `double heightSpread(List<Integer> groundHeights)` — The SITE domain's own metric (docs/spec/domains/site.md §3): the 90th-minus-10th-percentile of sampled ground heights (true ground, OCEAN_FLOOR_WG).
- `double waterFraction(int waterSamples, int totalSamples)` — Fraction of sampled columns identified as water, per docs/spec/domains/site.md §3.

### `class SeedSweepStatsTest` — `src/seedsweep/java/grounded_villages/harness/SeedSweepStatsTest.java`

### `class VillageSweepResult` — `src/seedsweep/java/grounded_villages/harness/VillageSweepResult.java`
One village's seed-sweep measurement (GV-10 acceptance criteria): start position, piece count, height spread and water fraction under its footprint, and the tier if the mod has set one (docs/spec/domains/tiers.md -- #tier is null when tier.enabled is false, otherwise the rolled tier's lower-case name, e.g.
- `VillageSweepResult(long seed, String structureId, int startX, int startY, int startZ, int pieceCount, double heightSpread, double waterFraction, int sampleCount, String tier, long runtimeMillis)`
